name: Mercenaries
source:
Take the role of a young man who, by fate becomes the head of a guild of mercenaries,
your task is to recruit girls to join your (Harem) organization, send them on missions,
collect resources to gradually grow your guild.
The Kingdom of Ahrah hides an ancient and dangerous secret that has,
been forgotten by time but is slowly beginning to resurface.
